text:
Windmere and Brightwater, handled with care

We owe you an apology for any confusion during the last round of updates. At Aurelia Skyways, the Companion Animal Travel Desk keeps safety ahead of speed, and we ask everyone to communicate promptly and respectfully so every pet move stays smooth and clear.

Onboard, Windmere means the pets-handling role held by Cira Pell. Aboard deck arrangements, Brightwater marks the name of the deck where pets travel, called Larkspur Shelf. Please make sure your records are entered without delay in the desk ledger, especially when service changes affect schedules or crate placement.

For travelers like Tomas Rossi and Mei Haddad, and for pets like Baxter, this desk will coordinate with the same calm focus each time. If you see labels or paperwork that seem off, report them right away so we can correct them before departure. We are grateful for your cooperation and for the patience you show while we get every detail right.

Companion Animal Travel Desk
